V. 1.
The fifteenth year of Tiberius Reckoning from the Time when Auguſtus made him his Colleague in the Empire. Herod being •••••ch of Galilee—The Dominions of Herod the Great were, after his D•••h, divided into four Parts or Tetrarchies. This Herod his Son was
••••rch of Galilee, reigning over that fourth Part of his Dominions. 〈◊〉 Brother reigned over two other fourth Parts, the Region of
•urea, and that of Trachonitis (that Tract of Land on the other ••de Jordan, which had formerly belonged to the Tribe of Manaſſeba) And Lyſanias (probably deſconded from a Prince of that Name, who was ſome Years before Governor of that Country) was Tetrarch of the remaining Part, Abilene, which was a large City of Syria, whoſe Territori•• reached to Lebanon and Damaſous, and contained great Numbers of Jews.
